tagline: Visual before/after field change log with highlights, summaries, and history viewer
problem: Odoo chatter shows raw field changes that are hard to scan when many values update at once.
solution: Field Difference Viewer builds structured before/after comparisons on top of standard mail.tracking.value data. Users get color-coded diffs, numeric deltas, history smart buttons, filters, and exports.
benefits: Readable before/after blocks instead of plain chatter lines
Numeric, date, boolean, and relational difference formatting
History smart button on sales, invoices, and CRM records
Filter by field type, user, or date
CSV and PDF export for audit teams

features.title: Visual comparisons
features.text: Show Before, After, and Difference for every tracked field change.

features.title: Smart summaries
features.text: See how many numeric, date, and text fields changed at a glance.

features.title: History viewer
features.text: Open a dedicated change log from the record smart button.

features.title: Audit exports
features.text: Export filtered change logs to CSV or PDF.

seo_keywords: Odoo 20 field diff, change log, audit trail, chatter viewer, before after comparison, ARMORA
